commands.author: chengzhichao-xydt

target.title: fix(ui): prevent Nostr profile publish/import hangs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Control UI Channels page could remain stuck on "publishing" or "importing" state indefinitely when the Nostr profile gateway endpoints stopped responding.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both `putNostrProfile` and `importNostrProfile` now attach a 30-second `AbortController` signal to their `fetch` calls. The deadline covers the response headers and the subsequent JSON body read, and the timeout timer is cleared on every exit path. Existing URL construction, header forwarding, response decoding, and caller-side error handling are preserved.

## User Impact

Operators editing or importing a Nostr channel profile now receive a bounded failure instead of the UI remaining unresponsive on a stalled gateway request.

## Evidence

Exact head: `67e7b746c9110538e3173e982ea148595fd778bd`.

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts --run` - 4 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts --run` - 4 tests passed (regression check on the only callers).
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts` - no findings.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- Tests verify fresh signals, the exact 30-second deadline boundary, and `TimeoutError` propagation for both publish and import paths.
- No visual layout or copy changed, so screenshots are not applicable.
- AI-assisted: implemented with Codex and reviewed with Claude. I inspected and understand the request-helper behavior.

Local proof used Node v22.22.0, slightly below the repository's v22.22.3 floor; GitHub CI is authoritative.

## Real behavior proof

Exact head: `67e7b746c9110538e3173e982ea148595fd778bd`.

A local real-HTTP proof was added in `scripts/proof-108077.mjs`. It starts a Node `http` server on `127.0.0.1`, exercises the unchanged production helpers through real `fetch` calls (with only a relative-to-absolute URL shim), and covers both the happy path and a stalled gateway that sends response headers but never sends a body.

Commands run:

```bash
node --import tsx scripts/proof-108077.mjs
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts --run
./node_modules/.bin/oxlint ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts scripts/proof-108077.mjs
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts scripts/proof-108077.mjs
```

Redacted proof output (timestamps and local port only):

```
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.106Z] starting local HTTP server
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.115Z] server listening at http://127.0.0.1:41375
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.143Z] === normal publish (PUT /profile) ===
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.162Z] server: PUT /api/channels/nostr/proof-account/profile (accountId=proof-account)
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.174Z] normal publish completed in 30.7 ms
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.174Z] normal publish response status: 200
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.174Z] normal publish data: {"ok":true,"persisted":true}
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.174Z] === normal import (POST /profile/import) ===
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.178Z] server: POST /api/channels/nostr/proof-account/profile/import (accountId=proof-account)
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.182Z] normal import completed in 7.9 ms
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.182Z] normal import response status: 200
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.182Z] normal import data: {"ok":true,"imported":{"name":"Imported Profile","about":"from gateway"},"saved":true}
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.183Z] === stalled publish timeout (PUT /profile?stall) ===
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.185Z] server: PUT /api/channels/nostr/proof-account/profile?stall (accountId=proof-account)
[2026-07-17T07:04:05.185Z] server: stalled response headers sent, holding socket open
[2026-07-17T07:04:35.188Z] stalled publish rejected after 30005.4 ms (expected ~30000 ms)
[2026-07-17T07:04:35.188Z] stalled publish error: name=TimeoutError message=nostr profile publish timed out
[2026-07-17T07:04:35.188Z] === stalled import timeout (POST /profile/import?stall) ===
[2026-07-17T07:04:35.194Z] server: POST /api/channels/nostr/proof-account/profile/import?stall (accountId=proof-account)
[2026-07-17T07:04:35.194Z] server: stalled response headers sent, holding socket open
[2026-07-17T07:05:05.189Z] stalled import rejected after 30001.2 ms (expected ~30000 ms)
[2026-07-17T07:05:05.190Z] stalled import error: name=TimeoutError message=nostr profile import timed out
[2026-07-17T07:05:05.190Z] PASS: all real-behavior proof scenarios completed
[2026-07-17T07:05:05.190Z] server stopped
```

The proof confirms:

- Normal publish and import complete quickly and return the expected JSON payloads.
- Stalled gateway requests (headers sent, body never sent) exit the pending state after the 30-second deadline.
- Both stalled paths reject with a `TimeoutError` whose message matches the production abort reason.

While building the proof, a body-read abort edge case was found and fixed in `ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts`: if the server sent response headers but the deadline fired while the JSON body was still streaming, the previous `.catch(() => null)` swallowed the abort and the helper resolved with `{ data: null, response }`. The helper now rethrows the abort/timeout error so callers receive the same bounded failure.
